thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered -> SEV1: high 5xx error rate on inference-gateway-eu-west.
Alert: PD#INC-2026-0042  —  metric: gateway.5xx_rate > 10% for 3m (now 18%).
Affected: inference-gateway-eu-west1 (traffic slice: eu-west-primary).
Symptoms: sudden surge of 504/502 and upstream connection resets. Possible deployy window ~ 02:10-02:30 UTC. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-0042

sam (oncall-sre): ack'd. I'm on it, will gather logs and check recent rollouts.

pagerbot: PagerDuty escalation: Rotation -> pager rotation: @jordan, @victor next.

jordan (platform): pulling up metrics — 5xx spike coincides with a canary rollout to sidecar-proxy v2.1 (10% weight) that started ~02:12 UTC. Canary hosts are showing high upstream resets.

emily (releases): confirmed — started canary for sidecar-proxy v2.1 at 02:12 UTC targeting 10% traffic for eu-west1. No error budget policy hit prior to this.

victor (sre): logs from a few canary pods: ```
[2026-03-15T02:16:14Z] proxy:error client_conn reset: upstream prematurely closed connection
[2026-03-15T02:16:15Z] proxy:warning backend 10.12.3.45: upstream response truncated
[2026-03-15T02:16:17Z] handler: returning 504 to client (request-id=abc123)
```
This pattern looks like the new sidecar is closing keepalives under load. Regular pods (non-canary) show normal responses.

sam (oncall-sre): ok. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) remove canary weight (route 0% to v2.1), 2) scale up stable pool if we need capacity, 3) if fixes needed, rollback canary. Who can flip traffic quickly?

jordan (platform): I can patch the rollout to 0% weight. Command: ```sh
kubectl -n prod patch canary sidecar-proxy --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic/weight","value":0}]'
```
I'll run that now.

emily (releases): also pausing the deployment: `flux suspend kustomization/sidecar-proxy` — will hold further changes.

jordan (platform): patched -> canary weight set to 0. Monitoring metrics...

victor (sre): immediate drop in 5xx rate starting within 30s of the patch. 5xx from 18% -> 3.2% and trending down.

pagerbot: PagerDuty note: INC-2026-0042 acknowledged by sam; escalation paused.

maria (support): CS rounding up impacted customers list — two enterprise customers reported elevated errors in EU region via support tickets. I'll open a bridge to notify them of mitigation and follow-up RCA.

sam (oncall-sre): Good. For now, rolling the canary back to v2.0 across eu-west1 and keeping monitoring for 15m. Jordan, can you trigger a quick rollback and restart the few canary pods?

jordan (platform): rolling back: ```sh
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/sidecar-proxy --to-revision=143
kubectl -n prod delete pods -l app=sidecar-proxy,canary=true
```
Rollback triggered. Pods terminating/recreating.

victor (sre): 5xx stabilized to baseline ~0.6% after rollback and pod restarts. No further cascading errors observed.

emily (releases): pausing all sidecar-proxy rollouts globally until RCA. I'll create a stop-gap gating rule for canary weight >0 requiring extra health checks.

sam (oncall-sre): thanks all. I'm marking the incident as mitigated — we'll keep the PD incident open for RCA and postmortem. Maria, please notify the affected customers with ETA for RCA.

maria (support): on it. Sending initial note: "We've mitigated the issue by removing a canary deployment; we will provide a full RCA in ~48-72 hours."

jordan (platform): quick note for the postmortem: capture kernel backlog / proxy keepalive changes in v2.1 and traffic pattern that exposed it. Also add a runbook step to automatically drain canary traffic if 5xx > 5% for 2 consecutive minutes.

sam (oncall-sre): filing follow-up tasks: - INCIDENT-2026-0042-RCA (owner: victor) - runbook update (owner: jordan) - customer comms thread (owner: maria).

victor (sre): I'll start the RCA and look into whether the regression is due to connection pooling differences in v2.1 or a cert renegotiation bug under HTTP/2.

sam (oncall-sre): marking this thread for handoff: oncall end in 30m, @jordan you are next on-call for the eu-west slice — please monitor for 2 hours.

jordan (platform): acknowledged. Will watch dashboards and alert thresholds for 2 hrs.

incident-bot: Note: PD incident INC-2026-0042 status -> mitigated (manual). Will auto-resolve if metrics remain healthy for 30m.

sam (oncall-sre): final check — adding a post-incident channel note and will schedule a brief sync with releases and SRE tomorrow. Closing operational thread here; keeping PD incident and RCA tasks open. :white_check_mark:
